rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns associated with Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel"
        tlp = "amber"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike_becon"
    strings:
        $a = { 60 8B ?? 0C 8B 4C ?? 04 8B 5C ?? 08 8B 74 ?? 0C 8B 7C ?? 10 8B E9 } // Common beacon shellcode pattern
        $b = "Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 8.0;" wide ascii
        $c = "x64" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
